conclusion: Source/release/native-decoder correspondence remains unresolved; no production mapping adopted

direct_source_facts.finding: Defines Frame index, box, eyes and coordinates relative to rotated frames; does not state numeric base or generation decoder.
Reads avg_frame_rate and passes -r rounded to two decimals for Android/laptop BMP export, using filename pattern _%03d.bmp.
Loads numeric matrix; fidx=M(:,1); t indexes annotation rows; output sidecar number is fidx(t)+1; eyes come from row t. No annotation-index video seek or array frame access.
Detects TAG:rotate=180 and prints notice; rotated variable never drives a transform in this file.
Existing >=100 BMP exports are reused; no check that each sidecar has a matching BMP.

inferences: Annotation i is associated with exported BMP ordinal i+1 by same-basename eye sidecars; BMP numbering starts at 001 in controlled bundled exports. This supports zero-based exported-image ordinal semantics, not a native decoder index guarantee.
Rounded-rate output can duplicate frames: a fixed native offset is not implied by MATLAB row indexing.
